game.name: ROBLOX: Tower Defense Simulator
game.rules:
**Timing Rules:**

The Recorded Time is the time displayed on the real end game triumph screen.

**Submission Rules:**

### Video Rules

• MUST include a YouTube or Twitch video of your run. Videos from iCloud, Google Drive, Desktop Folder, etc. cannot be accepted. The video cannot be private or hidden.

• MUST include the FULL run. Runs must start BEFORE WAVE 1, and end after the end screen is displayed. Cuts in the run are not allowed.

• MUST show at least a full second, with the time readable, of the End Game Triumph Screen

• MUST be raw footage gameplay.. Timelapses and slow motions cannot be accepted.

• MUST be decent quality enough for the run to be able to watch throughout the video

### Speedrun.com Rules

When submitting your run, remember to submit it into the correct category and leaderboard. The run will be redirected if it’s submitted into the wrong category. However, runs will have the be rejected if it’s submitted into the wrong leaderboard.

**BANNED Items:**

• NO use of any type of consumables

• NO use of any glitches, hacks, or admin commands

• NO submitting runs if you’re drowning in quicksand

categories.name: All Modes (Even even more legacy)
categories.rules:
[Video required] Complete every single mode (Normal, Molten, Fallen) of the game as fast as possible.
Starting from the start of any map, time ends when all modes are completed.

Must:

- The Run must be done in a single segment.
- Video must include being in the lobby and being on the browser. (If you use a software like OBS, you would have to capture your screen during the entirety of the run.)
- Time is the sum of all times that can be seen on the end screens.
- You cannot close your game to preemptively finish a game. You must display the End Screen. If a Teleport Fail occurs, however, you may close the game and not count the time for that game.
- You cannot trade different players when doing the next mode.
- Run has to be done on the same map throughout.
